description:
Record a question TerraVue could not answer, so it can be built. Call this whenever
    a user asks for something outside the current tools' coverage (rental metrics, Airbnb
    modeling, valuations, move-vs-stay, non-US, anything else), then tell the user their
    request was captured. Keep `description` to the capability needed — no names, emails,
    or other personal details.

    category: rental_metrics | str_airbnb | valuation | move_vs_stay | data_coverage | other

category.description: One of: rental_metrics, str_airbnb, valuation, move_vs_stay, data_coverage, other.
category.title: Category

description.description: What the user asked for that TerraVue could not do, in one or two sentences. The capability only — never names, emails, addresses or other personal details.
description.title: Description

name: request_capability
